bio: A family-owned business that, in homage to its origins, takes its name from the famous Belgian singer Jacques Brel, renowned worldwide for his song “Ne me quitte pas”. This restaurant, which initially operated as a pizzeria, boasts a superb beach location and an attractive interior that is bright, spacious and designed in contemporary style, and features a special bar-style table in front of the glass-fronted kitchen. The contemporary Mediterranean menu is high on detail, with specific sections for fresh pasta, innovative pizzas and Asian-inspired dishes....
